historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission unanimously designated the vacant, wooded hilltop lot beside the Comstock apartment building for public recreational use in the Master Plan (Resolution 7635).
The City Planning Commission unanimously refused to reclassify the lot from RM-3 to RM-4 (Resolution 8164).
The City Planning Commission approved, 5-2, enlarging the penthouse of the residential building, already above 40 feet (Motion 14214).
